issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'בְּמַעֲלֵה גוּר' means 'at the ascent of Gur' (a place name, 'Gur'), but the Chinese renders it as '以伯蓮的幼獸階梯' ('the young-animal staircase of Ibleam'), which misidentifies 'Gur' as '幼獸' (young animal) and adds '以伯蓮' (Ibleam) as a possessive, changing the place name and meaning.
